linesContent.text: Weapon Kills grant 1 Stack of Adrenaline Junkie for 4.5 seconds. Grenade Kills grant all 5 Stacks instantly even if the weapon is stowed.

limitations: Bungie Oct13 manifest and Oracle May20 curves are separate pinned snapshots. Community timings are historical approximations, not exact official animation measurements.

Clarity weapon kill +1, grenade kill instantly5 even stowed, 4.5s duration, handling+20 and stack damage are source mechanics. Runtime attribution, refresh, lifecycle and cycle integration are master-owned.
Only handling is modified. No reload stat bonus, reload curve or timing override is introduced.
Stat clamp0..100; stow-at100 floor; W44 ADS2..20ticks; no extra ready/stow clamp; ceil seconds*20 once.

Goldtusk remains among all5 damage-eligible rolls, but official Handling stat and Oracle sword curve are absent. Timing is explicitly unsupported with null ticks and no curve; consumers retain their sword baseline.
Nezarec glaive ADS is unsupported by W44; exact zero Oracle curve maps to existing neutral2ticks. Ready/stow have measured curves.

No selected AJ roll has official base Snapshot membership. Empty intersection is pinned; Snapshot requests fail closed. Future approved pairs must apply official W68 scalar to raw baseHandling+20 ADS seconds before one ceil, never to rounded ticks. W68 historical Special .75 vs selected .8 conflict remains unresolved.
Combined perks, armor, masterworks, combat runtime, native Vision and final gates are master-owned. Enhanced AJ is excluded.
